items.source: Activates when there is no bean of type MongoRepositoryFactoryBean configured in the context, the Spring Data Mongo MongoRepository type is on the classpath, the Mongo client driver API is on the classpath, and there is no other configured MongoRepository.
items.translation: 在上下文中未配置类型为`MongoRepositoryFactoryBean`的 Bean、Spring Data Mongo 的`MongoRepository`类型位于类路径中、Mongo 客户端驱动程序 API 位于类路径中，且没有其他配置的`MongoRepository`时激活。

items.source: Once in effect, the auto-configuration is the equivalent of enabling Mongo repositories using the @EnableMongoRepositories annotation.
items.translation: 一旦生效，自动配置等同于使用 @EnableMongoRepositories` 注解启用 Mongo 存储库。

items.source: Dave Syer, Oliver Gierke, Josh Long
